subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? We would like this closed out ahead of the next submittal deadline. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up any current work. Please respond within five days so we can proceed with fabrication. We can't tell if this is a deliberate design call or just a coordination slip in how it was documented.

Sheet A-201 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 71 00 interior door hardware set at the stair enclosure; we'll reconcile Door and Window Schedule A-601 by addendum. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is not holding up any current work.
